issues.title: [US-01] QA: Job Seeker registration test evidence
issues.parentAcceptanceCriteria:
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given Emily has installed the app and is not logged in, when she taps Register from the entry/login screen, then the app shows a registration screen containing name, email, password, password confirmation, and a role selector with Job Seeker selectable, without asking her to authenticate.
- [ ] Given Emily is on the registration screen, when she taps submit with a required field empty or the email not in a valid email format, then the app keeps her on the screen, marks each offending field with an English validation message, and sends no registration request.
- [ ] Given Emily has entered a password and a different value in password confirmation, when she taps submit, then the app shows a mismatch error on the confirmation field and sends no registration request.
- [ ] Given Emily has completed all fields with Job Seeker selected, when she taps submit, then the app sends name, email, password, and the Job Seeker role to the backend registration endpoint and shows a processing state until the backend responds (creation outcome is verified under US-02 and US-03).
issues.parentEvidenceRequirements:
## Evidence
_Fill in when the story closes: link the PR, the tests and the device recordings that prove the acceptance criteria._
- [ ] PR: registration screen and on-device validation merged into `dev`
- [ ] Test: AT-US-01-1 (registration screen opens unauthenticated with all five fields) and AT-US-01-2 (required-field, email-format, and confirmation-mismatch validation) passing
- [ ] Unit tests: form validation rules (FE)
- [ ] Screenshots: registration screen and validation errors on iOS and Android
- [ ] QA sign-off recorded on this issue

issues.title: [US-02] QA: Account creation and hash-only storage evidence
issues.parentAcceptanceCriteria:
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given Emily submits the registration form with valid data and an unused email (US-01), when the backend processes the request, then a Job Seeker account is created and the stored credential is a password hash only, with no plaintext password persisted.
- [ ] Given the backend has confirmed account creation, when the app receives the success response, then it shows an English success message and navigates to the login screen without creating an authenticated session or storing a token.
- [ ] Given the backend has not yet responded, or returns a network or server error, when Emily waits on the registration screen, then the app shows a processing or error state and neither shows success nor navigates to login.
- [ ] Given a request to the registration endpoint that omits a required field or carries an unsupported role value, when the backend processes it, then it rejects the request with a validation error and no account is created, regardless of any on-device validation.
issues.parentEvidenceRequirements:
## Evidence
_Fill in when the story closes: link the PR, the tests and the device recordings that prove the acceptance criteria._
- [ ] PR: registration endpoint, password hashing, and app success/error handling merged into `dev`
- [ ] Test: AT-US-02-1 (valid registration creates account with hashed password and navigates to login) and AT-US-02-2 (server-side validation rejects invalid payload) passing
- [ ] Integration test: registration endpoint including hash-only storage check (BE)
- [ ] Screen recording: registration success to login screen on iOS and Android
- [ ] QA sign-off recorded on this issue

issues.title: [US-03] QA: Duplicate-email registration test evidence
issues.parentAcceptanceCriteria:
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given an account already exists with Jacob's email, when he submits the registration form with that email, then the backend rejects the request and exactly one account with that email exists afterwards.
- [ ] Given the backend returned the duplicate-email rejection, when the app handles the response, then Jacob stays on the registration screen with his entered values retained and sees a clear English form-level error stating that the email is already registered.
- [ ] Given the duplicate error is displayed, when Jacob changes the email to an unused one and resubmits, then the account is created and the app behaves as in US-02.

issues.title: [US-06] QA: Login and role routing test evidence
issues.parentAcceptanceCriteria:
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given Jacob has a Job Seeker account, when he enters the correct email and password and taps Log in, then the backend returns a JWT, the app stores it in device secure storage, and navigates to the Job Seeker home with navigation to Marketplace and Forum.
- [ ] Given David has a Career Counsellor account, when he logs in with correct credentials, then the app routes him to the counsellor area rather than the Job Seeker home (first-login onboarding routing is verified under US-05).
- [ ] Given a Platform Owner account has been seeded in the test environment, when that user logs in with correct credentials, then the app routes them to a Platform Owner area distinct from the Job Seeker home and the counsellor area (the oversight functions themselves are delivered under US-58, US-48, US-52).
- [ ] Given Jacob is logged in as a Job Seeker, when his token is used to call a counsellor-only or Platform-Owner-only endpoint, then the backend rejects the request on role regardless of what the app shows.
- [ ] Given the login request is in flight or the backend is unreachable, when Jacob waits on the login screen, then the app shows a loading state and does not navigate to any home screen until the backend confirms authentication.

issues.title: [US-30] QA: Professional profile test evidence
issues.parentAcceptanceCriteria:
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given a signed-in Career Counsellor with no professional profile, when they open the Professional Profile screen, provide photo, introduction, background, qualifications, experience, spoken languages, base location and default modality, and tap Save, then the app shows success only after the backend confirms the profile is stored, and reopening the screen shows the saved values.
- [ ] Given a counsellor with an existing professional profile, when they edit any of those fields and tap Save, then the backend stores the change and the updated values appear on the counsellor's profile view returned by the backend.
- [ ] Given the default modality control, when the counsellor opens it, then the only options offered are online, in-person or both.
- [ ] Given the backend returns a validation error for the submitted profile, when the counsellor taps Save, then the app shows the error against the relevant field(s) in English, keeps the entered values, and does not show success.
- [ ] Given a Job Seeker session or a different counsellor's session, when the professional-profile update endpoint is called for this counsellor, then the backend rejects the request and the profile is unchanged.
- [ ] Given a counsellor whose verification is still pending, when they open the Professional Profile screen, then they can create and edit the profile without being blocked by verification status.

issues.title: [US-47] QA: End-to-end purchase test evidence
issues.parentAcceptanceCriteria:
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given a signed-in Job Seeker has selected a service, an open slot and entered the pre-session brief, when they proceed to purchase, then the app shows a review step with the service, slot time with timezone, modality, service price, Yoir commission and Career Professional amount before any payment is attempted.
- [ ] Given the review step, when the Job Seeker confirms and the payment boundary reports success, then the backend records an order and transaction in a successful state linked to the booking, and the app shows the order status returned by the backend.
- [ ] Given the payment boundary reports failure, or an unknown or incomplete result, when the backend processes it, then the transaction is recorded in a non-successful state, the booking is not confirmed, and the app shows that non-successful (failed or pending) state as returned by the backend without claiming success.
- [ ] Given a payment confirmation (webhook or callback) is delivered more than once for the same transaction, when the backend processes the repeat, then no duplicate order, transaction or booking is created and the recorded state is unchanged.
- [ ] Given any completed or failed purchase, when QA inspects the backend database and logs, then no raw card number, expiry or CVV is stored by Yoir, card entry having occurred only inside the provider SDK or sandbox boundary.
- [ ] Given a request to create or pay an order without a valid session token, when the backend receives it, then it rejects the request with an authentication error and no order or transaction is created.
